source: Lancet Commission on Dementia Prevention, Intervention, and Care (Livingston et al., 2020, 2024 updates)
provenance_note: literature-informed prior, not learned from ADNI

smoking.label: Smoking status
smoking.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Current smoking pooled RR=1.59 (95% CI 1.15-2.20).

physical_activity.label: Physical activity
physical_activity.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Physical inactivity pooled RR=1.39 (95% CI 1.14-1.69). Active lifestyle RR=0.85.

alcohol.label: Alcohol consumption
alcohol.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Excessive alcohol (>21 units/week) pooled RR=1.19 (95% CI 1.01-1.40). Moderate/none RR=1.0.

diet_quality.label: Diet quality
diet_quality.citation: Morris et al. (Alzheimers Dement 2015); Lancet Commission 2024: Mediterranean/MIND diet RR=0.88; low-quality diet RR=1.20.

sleep_quality.label: Sleep quality
sleep_quality.citation: Bubu et al. (Sleep 2017); Lancet Commission 2024: Sleep disturbance and chronic insomnia RR=1.25 (95% CI 1.08-1.45).

hypertension.label: Hypertension
hypertension.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Midlife hypertension (systolic >= 140 mmHg) pooled RR=1.61 (95% CI 1.17-2.22).

diabetes.label: Type 2 Diabetes
diabetes.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Type 2 diabetes pooled RR=1.52 (95% CI 1.18-1.96).

depression.label: Depression
depression.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Late-life depression pooled RR=1.91 (95% CI 1.51-2.42).

head_injury.label: Traumatic Brain Injury
head_injury.citation: Lancet Commission (2020/2024): Traumatic brain injury history pooled RR=1.78 (95% CI 1.29-2.46).

cardiovascular_disease.label: Cardiovascular disease
cardiovascular_disease.citation: Newman et al. (2005); Lancet Commission 2024: Clinical cardiovascular disease history RR=1.28 (95% CI 1.05-1.56).
